resolution_notes: base_url: Replace. Official 2026 Trestle documentation names https://api.cotality.com as the base URL and identifies api-prod.corelogic.com as a deprecated endpoint: https://trestle-documentation.corelogic.com/webapi.html. example: Replace. The same official guide documents OAuth2 bearer authentication and GET /trestle/odata/Property; the resource reference confirms that path: https://api.cotality.com/trestle/Documentation/MetaData/Resource/Property.
